newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen B shares close weaker, trade lacklustre.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares close weaker, trade lacklustre.

text.p: Shenzhen's hard currency B shares finished lower on Thursday as most investors kept to the sidelines to wait for clearer market direction, brokers said.
The index ended off 0.44 point or 0.34 percent to 129.60 on turnover of HK$43 million against HK$39 milliion in the previous session.

The domestic A share index edged down 0.23 point or 0.06 percent to 407.49, pressured by slight profit-taking after rises over the past two days, brokers said. Turnover on the A share market was 4.4 billion yuan against Wednesday's 4.6 billion.
